contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents continuing real Brian-owned Enforced Planning work without remembering outcome-admission flags
contract.outcome: The Enforced Planning source lifecycle and native pre-write automatically enforce the exact selected outcome while retaining one restricted bootstrap and recoverable rollback.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The exact Plan 123 bootstrap claim owns only its plan, graph, index, roadmap, and Plan-numbered allocation inputs; source outcome admission is still explicit-only.
canonical_journey.input: One Project Graph-bound maintenance allocation, one exact selected scenario, and source configuration set to enforce_selected.
canonical_journey.action: Upgrade, allocate, select, expand, and then invoke the real Make lifecycle and installed source pre-write hook without any outcome flag.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Active exact state succeeds with outcome_admission_active receipts; missing, inactive, or circular state returns nonzero before protected mutation or write success.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Omitting a flag bypasses the gate, bootstrap admits source work, a stale mirror owns the Make path, approval or cost changes the result, or any downstream repository changes.
